warm-t3.method: Shared physical LPM root per state; separate Bun root. All forward/reverse rotations balance pair direction. Seeded and warmed twice; reset state outside measurement; rotating variant/scenario order; every scored install retained; no timing instrumentation on scored installs; inventories and lockfiles retained; no repeated seed downloads.
